MATTEL WWE ELITE 74 UP FOR PRE-ORDER! NATALYA, LINCE DORADO & MORE!

WWE Elite 74 is the 78th series in the WWE Elite toy line. The set includes six figures: Finn Balor, AJ Styles, Goldberg, Andrade, Lince Dorado & Natalya, with Jim Neidhart as the Walmart Collector's Edition exclusive. This is Lince's very first figure and he happens to have two in this set as one is the chase variant. The chase is the gold version, which has some color and design variations from the main release in black/blue.
Capture the blowout action of WWE Superstars with this Elite Collection action figure!
